name: com.metz.jamkit
description: Rapid game-jam toolkit for Unity 6.6. Ripple owns state and events, JamKit owns the rest of hour one: self-hosting services (time, scenes, input, screen fade), backend-neutral audio, tweens and camera shake, gameplay primitives, UI Toolkit menus and editor tooling. Requires Odin Inspector and Ripple; Feel and FMOD are optional.
